nom: SUNDAY RILEY A.I. Adaptive Retinoid Serum

segments.oily: The few reviewers who describe oily-leaning or oily-combination skin say the serum controls excess oil and refines pores, with one noting a little extra dryness in the first couple of days before her skin settled.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or combination-dry skin have mixed experiences: some say dry patches disappeared and skin stayed soft without extra moisturizer, while others — including one whose skin turns very dry in winter — report flaking or a need to layer more moisturizer with it.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including combination-dry, combination-oily and rosacea-prone combination skin, generally report calmer, clearer, more balanced skin without new irritation, and some say it succeeds where other retinoids previously dried them out or triggered breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mostly positive, including several who say they normally can't tolerate retinoids at all and describe this one as the first that didn't burn, sting or trigger breakouts; one reviewer with sensitive skin says it still didn't agree with her, though her acne improved slightly.
segments.normal: One reviewer who describes her skin as combination leaning normal says it works well without greasiness or stickiness.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s or dealing with perimenopause say the serum helped with dullness, fine lines, mild acne and hormonal breakouts, describing brighter, smoother, more youthful-looking skin without added dryness.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers say fine lines look softer or less pronounced after two or more weeks of use, including one who credits it with easing early aging signs without the dryness other retinoids cause her; one reviewer disagrees, saying it did not help with wrinkles or lines for her and is better suited to pore and oil control.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the serum absorbs without leaving skin tight or dry, and some highlight that it hydrates well compared to other retinoids; a meaningful minority — including one whose skin turns very dry in winter — report flaking, dryness, or a need for extra moisturizer, especially in the first few days or in cold weather.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness, including several with rosacea, consistently say the serum calms it within one to several weeks alongside fewer breakouts and clearer pores; none in this set report increased redness.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers say dark spots or old acne marks visibly fade with continued use, though one reviewer who hoped it would help her hyperpigmentation says it's too early in her use to confirm that result.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of acne-prone or blemish-prone reviewers report fewer, less severe or faster-healing breakouts within one to several weeks, including several who say typical retinoids don't agree with their skin but this one does; two reviewers mention an initial 'purge' period with a breakout before things improved, and a couple saw no noticeable change at all.
concerns.oiliness: The reviewers who mention oily or oil-prone skin say the serum helps control excess oil and refine pores without adding dryness.

extraits.texte: This wasn't my favorite product. Initially the smell wasn't super pleasant. I used it consistently and didn't see any benefits and if anything found my skin to get a bit dry and scratchy which was literally the opposite of what it says it would do. Would not buy it again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My skin is quite sensitive and this product didn't quite agree with it. However, I did notice that my acne cleared up a bit! So that was nice! I would recommend to those with skin that isn't sensitive.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this product for 2 weeks now, and I can give a more complete and honest opinion about how it worked on my skin. My skin is combination and tends to get dehydrated in certain areas, so I usually notice quickly when something works for me. One of the first things I noticed during the first week was that those dry patches around my nose and mouth disappeared. Even on very hot days, my skin stayed soft without feeling tight. When applying makeup, some foundations used to settle into my pores, but with consistent use, that uneven texture improved quite a bit. As for the duller areas of my face, I wouldn't say it "whitened" my skin or anything extreme, but I did notice a more luminous appearance, especially in the mornings. My skin looked fresher, as if I had rested better. The product absorbs quickly, doesn't leave a sticky feeling, and works well under sunscreen and makeup. It didn't cause any breakouts, which is very important to me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So let me start off by saying I tried this product for over a month consistently. For a retinol this is an excellent choice. However my skin in the winter tends to be VERY dry. I did notice some flaking on my face but again I would blame this on my own skin not the product itself. My overall skin barrier and skin itself does look way better. Blemishes are gone. I would give this product 5 stars if my skin wasn't so dry.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've always had tricky skin combination but on the dry side, super sensitive, and prone to breakouts. Retinoids are a must for me now that I'm in my mid-thirties, but almost every retinoid I've tried has either dried me out even more or triggered new blemishes. So I was honestly nervous to try anything new. I'm so glad I gave the Sunday Riley AI Smart Retinoid Seruma chance. This formula uses two advanced retinoids, and it somehow manages to be both powerful and gentle at the same time. I haven't had a single breakout from it which is rare for my skin. Instead, it's actually helped calm and prevent them. My pores look clearer, my stubborn post acne marks are fading, and my overall texture looks smoother. On top of that, it's already softening some early signs of aging without causing the dryness I usually get with retinoids. If you have combination, sensitive, or blemish-prone skin and you want something that targets both breakouts and early aging, this serum is absolutely worth trying. It's become a must have in my routine.

I was gifted this item for my honest review. A little about myself, I am over 40 years of age with acne prone skin. I also have rosacea. It is very important to me to find quality skin care products to use on my skin. This Sunday Riley AI product is amazing. Is a very nice smooth serum that goes on my face easily and does not cause any irritation. The scent of the product is also pleasant as it does not have an overwhelming smell. I have been using this product for about a month now and it's starting to improve my acne. I will continue to use this product as it has been given me great results.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Sunday Riley A.I. Adaptive Retinoid Serum as part of my nightly skincare routine and I'm impressed! It has improved the appearance of pores and texture. I am also starting to see dark spots lighten and fine lines appear softer. My skin looks softer, smoother, and more youthful. I follow this serum up with my favorite moisturizer and it hasn't caused any irritation or dryness.
